newsitem.title: USA: MOSCOM says VOTAN unit files for IPO.
newsitem.headline: MOSCOM says VOTAN unit files for IPO.

text.p: MOSCOM Corp said on Wednesday its Votan Corp unit filed an amended registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission relating to an initial public offering of 1,600,000 shares of Votan common stock.
All of the shares being sold are newly issued shares to be sold by Votan. Following the offering, MOSCOM will own approximately 50 percent of the outstanding shares of Votan.
Votan Corporation, headquartered in Pleasanton, California, is a leading developer of advanced speech technologies utilized in voice verification and speech recognition applications.

Votan intends to use the net proceeds of the offering primarily for expansion of sales and marketing activities, research and development, repayment of an inter-company loan to MOSCOM, and general working capital.
